description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki Aluminum Valve Cover Kit for the G16A & G16BA Engine
This will fit Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 with 1.6L Upgrade Engine.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Valve Cover, Aluminum
Qty 1 – 16V Gasket
Qty 1 – Oil Fill Cap
Qty 4 – Grommets, Spark Plug
Qty 6 – Bolts
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models with 16V/1.6L
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models with 16V/1.6L
